Veeam.title: Autonomy Is Only Safe When It Is Reversible
Veeam.summary: Somewhere in your organization, an AI agent has permission to do real work. It reads records, updates systems, moves data, and finishes tasks without asking anyone, which is exactly what you hired it for. The same permission that lets it work also lets it do damage. And there’s no version of the agent that gets one without the other. The post Autonomy Is Only Safe When It Is Reversible appeared first on Veeam Software Official Blog .

Cisco.title: Cisco Unified Intelligence Center SQL Injection Vulnerability
Cisco.summary: A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of Cisco Unified Intelligence Center could allow an authenticated, local attacker to perform a blind SQL injection attack against an affected device. This vulnerability is due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted request to the web-based management interface. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to read the contents of the internal database of an affected device. To exploit this vulnerability, the attacker must…
